request.prompt: Ten-second title-led motion film, muted ochre and charcoal. A narrow luminous terracotta frame opens out across a black film leader, and the words AI Video Expander slide into focus with the opening. Hold that single correctly spelled phrase long enough to read, with strong light-on-dark contrast and no other type. The frame carries into a tall view of a cyclist on a concrete terrace, then into a wide view of musicians entering a small rehearsal space. Frame lines reveal extra surroundings before dissolving. Keep cuts precise, textures photographic and subjects easy to see. Soft film-projector rhythm, no voice. Exclude Chinese text and traditional Chinese visual elements. Avoid logos, watermarks, broken geometry and extra text.
